```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(y)
  if (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x)) return(y)
  x
}

source_app <- function(file) {
  path <- file.path("R", file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("sap_preview.Rmd cannot find R/", file, " (working directory: ", getwd(), ")")
  }
  source(path, local = knitr::knit_global())
}
for (f in c("cohort_kinds.R", "utils.R")) source_app(f)

sap_item_by_id    <- shinySAP::sapItemById
item_label        <- shinySAP::sapItemLabel
is_denominator_type <- shinySAP::sapIsDenominatorType

is_word <- isTRUE(knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to") == "docx")

sap   <- params$sap
study <- sap$study %||% list()

library(flextable)
set_flextable_defaults(font.family = "Calibri", font.size = 10)

# A two-column label/value table, skipping rows with no value.
field_table <- function(rows) {
  rows <- Filter(function(r) !is.null(r[2]) && !is.na(r[2]) && nzchar(trimws(r[2])), rows)
  if (!length(rows)) return(invisible(NULL))
  df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, rows), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df) <- c("Field", "Value")
  ft <- flextable(df) |>
    bold(j = 1) |>
    border_remove() |>
    hline(border = officer::fp_border(color = "#DDDDDD", width = 0.5)) |>
    set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1) |>
    padding(padding = 4) |>
    fontsize(size = 10)
  if (nrow(df) >= 2) ft <- bg(ft, i = seq(2, nrow(df), 2), bg = "#F5F5F5")
  ft
}

items_table <- function(df) {
  ft <- flextable(df) |>
    bold(part = "header") |>
    border_remove() |>
    hline(border = officer::fp_border(color = "#DDDDDD", width = 0.5)) |>
    set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1) |>
    padding(padding = 4) |>
    fontsize(size = 10)
  if (nrow(df) >= 2) ft <- bg(ft, i = seq(2, nrow(df), 2), bg = "#F5F5F5")
  ft
}

chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x %||% "")[1]
  if (is.na(x)) "" else x
}
dash <- function(x) if (nzchar(trimws(x))) x else "—"

type_label <- function(object, type) {
  types <- shinySAP::sapSchemaTypes(object)
  hit <- names(types)[match(chr(type), types)]
  if (is.na(hit)) dash(chr(type)) else hit
}

# Cohort ids -> names, so the document never shows an id where a name exists.
cohort_name <- function(id) {
  co <- sap_item_by_id(sap$cohorts, id)
  if (is.null(co)) chr(id) else item_label(co, "cohort")
}
codelist_name <- function(id) {
  cl <- sap_item_by_id(sap$codelists, id)
  if (is.null(cl)) chr(id) else item_label(cl, "codelist")
}

# When an item runs on every data source -- the usual case -- its cell says so
# in two words instead of repeating the same five names on every row.
all_sources <- shinySAP:::sap_source_names(sap)
sources_cell <- function(x) {
  ds <- shinySAP:::data_source_names(sap, x$data_source_id)
  if (!length(ds)) return("—")
  if (length(all_sources) && setequal(ds, all_sources)) return("All data sources")
  paste(ds, collapse = ", ")
}

# A parameter as prose, by its value type and key.
parameter_text <- function(key, value, value_type) {
  if (is.null(value)) return(NULL)
  if (grepl("_cohort_id$", key)) return(paste(vapply(chr_vec(value), cohort_name, character(1)), collapse = ", "))
  if (identical(key, "codelist_id")) return(codelist_name(value))
  switch(as.character(value_type),
    logic = if (isTRUE(value)) "yes" else "no",
    integer = if (is.infinite(value)) "unbounded" else format(value),
    date = format(as.Date(value), "%Y-%m-%d"),
    date_range = {
      dr <- as.Date(value)
      sprintf("%s to %s",
              if (is.na(dr[[1]])) "start of available data" else format(dr[[1]]),
              if (is.na(dr[[2]])) "end of available data" else format(dr[[2]]))
    },
    age_group = paste(format_bound_list(value, open = AGE_MAX), collapse = "; "),
    time_at_risk = paste(format_bound_list(value, open = "∞"), collapse = "; "),
    strata = paste(vapply(value, function(g) paste(as.character(unlist(g)), collapse = " × "),
                          character(1)), collapse = "\n"),
    paste(as.character(unlist(value)), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Every parameter an item carries, labelled from the schema, one per line.
parameters_text <- function(object, item) {
  p <- item$parameters %||% list()
  if (!length(p)) return("")
  fields <- shinySAP::sapSchemaFields(object, item$type)
  fields <- fields[grepl("^parameters\\.", fields$path), , drop = FALSE]
  keys <- sub("^parameters\\.", "", fields$path)
  lines <- character(0)
  for (i in seq_along(keys)) {
    txt <- parameter_text(keys[[i]], p[[keys[[i]]]], fields$value_type[[i]])
    if (!is.null(txt) && nzchar(txt)) {
      lines <- c(lines, sprintf("%s: %s", gsub("_", " ", keys[[i]]), txt))
    }
  }
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}
```

# Data sources

```{r data-sources, results='asis'}
sources <- sap$data_sources %||% list()
if (!length(sources)) {
  cat("_No data sources defined._\n")
} else {
  df <- data.frame(
    `Id`   = vapply(sources, function(s) chr(s$id), character(1)),
    `Name` = vapply(sources, function(s) dash(chr(s$name)), character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(items_table(df))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r modifications, results='asis'}
mods <- sap$data_source_modifications %||% list()
if (length(mods)) {
  cat("\n**Modifications applied before analysis**\n\n")
  df <- data.frame(
    `Modification` = vapply(mods, function(m) item_label(m, "modification"), character(1)),
    `Type`         = vapply(mods, function(m) type_label("data_source_modification", m$type), character(1)),
    `Data sources` = vapply(mods, sources_cell, character(1)),
    `Details`      = vapply(mods, function(m) parameters_text("data_source_modification", m), character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(items_table(df))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Codelists

```{r codelists, results='asis'}
codelists <- sap$codelists %||% list()
if (!length(codelists)) {
  cat("_No codelists defined._\n")
} else {
  # The codes live in the SAP; their full listing is the last appendix. Here:
  # what each codelist is and how big it is.
  df <- data.frame(
    `Codelist` = vapply(codelists, function(cl) item_label(cl, "codelist"), character(1)),
    `Type`     = vapply(codelists, function(cl) type_label("codelist", cl$type), character(1)),
    `Content`  = vapply(codelists, function(cl) shinySAP:::codelist_content_summary(cl$content), character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(items_table(df))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Description of cohorts

```{r cohorts, results='asis'}
cohorts <- sap$cohorts %||% list()
if (!length(cohorts)) {
  cat("_No cohorts defined._\n")
} else {
  cohort_details <- function(co) {
    txt <- parameters_text("cohort", co)
    if (is_denominator_type(co$type)) {
      txt <- paste(c(txt, sprintf("cohorts generated: %d", length(denominator_cohort_set(co)))),
                   collapse = "\n")
    }
    txt
  }
  df <- data.frame(
    `Cohort`       = vapply(cohorts, function(co) item_label(co, "cohort"), character(1)),
    `Type`         = vapply(cohorts, function(co) type_label("cohort", co$type), character(1)),
    `Data sources` = vapply(cohorts, sources_cell, character(1)),
    `Definition`   = vapply(cohorts, cohort_details, character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(items_table(df))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Analyses

```{r analyses, results='asis'}
analyses <- sap$analyses %||% list()
if (!length(analyses)) {
  cat("_No analyses defined._\n")
} else {
  # Every argument the author decided, one row per analysis. The generated calls
  # live in the appendix under each analysis's own heading.
  df <- data.frame(
    `Analysis`     = vapply(analyses, function(a) item_label(a, "analysis"), character(1)),
    `Type`         = vapply(analyses, function(a) type_label("analysis", a$type), character(1)),
    `Data sources` = vapply(analyses, sources_cell, character(1)),
    `Details`      = vapply(analyses, function(a) parameters_text("analysis", a), character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(items_table(df))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Appendix: codelist contents

```{r codelist-contents, results='asis'}
codelists <- sap$codelists %||% list()
with_content <- Filter(function(cl) !is.null(cl$content), codelists)
if (!length(with_content)) {
  cat("_No codelist carries codes yet._\n")
} else {
  for (cl in with_content) {
    cat("\n\n## ", item_label(cl, "codelist"), "\n\n", sep = "")
    content <- unclass(cl$content)
    for (set in names(content)) {
      x <- content[[set]]
      cat("**", set, "**\n\n", sep = "")
      df <- if (is.data.frame(x)) as.data.frame(x) else data.frame(concept_id = x)
      flextable::flextable_to_rmd(items_table(df))
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```
